# Platform Evaluation

> Used by `ngn-earnings-research`, `uk-earnings-research`, `us-earnings-research` for each new platform.

## Platform Metadata

- **Name**: {Platform name}
- **Category**: ai-training / surveys-microtasks / user-testing / bank-switching / cashback-receipts / mystery-shopping / freelance-gigs / passive-apps
- **Country eligibility**: {NGN/UK/US/global}
- **Payout methods**: {PayPal / bank transfer / gift card / crypto}

## Evaluation Fields

| Field | Details |
|| ----- | ------- ||
| Signup requirements | {KYC, ID, PayPal needed} |
| Pay model | {per-task, hourly, per-survey, per-switch} |
| Realistic earnings | {estimate per hour/week} |
| Minimum payout | {threshold} |
| Payment speed | {instant / 24h / monthly} |
| Task availability | {steady vs sparse} |
| Pros | {bulleted} |
| Cons / risks | {bulleted} |
| Scam risk | low / medium / high (+ why) |
| Rating | {1-5} |
| Verdict | {recommended / cautious / avoid} |

## Saved As

`platforms/{category}/{platform_name}.md`
